item.title: Sailors and their families have lives on pause, uncertain if they'll return to Mideast
item.description: Sailors and family members who were evacuated from U.S. bases in the Middle East months ago are waiting for the military to figure out what will happen to the lives they left behind.
item.content:encoded:

item.title: These swing voters in Nevada say they are not dismissing socialist candidates
item.description: In online focus groups, 10 of 12 Biden-to-Trump voters said they wouldn't automatically think negatively of a politician who identifies with socialism.

item.title: New indictment alleges Nick Reiner was lying in wait before killing his parents
item.description: A grand jury has indicted Nick Reiner on murder charges in the killings of his parents, Rob Reiner and Michele Singer Reiner, and adds the allegation that he was lying in wait before attacking them.
item.content:encoded:

item.title: Millions crowd cities to see Spain's first total solar eclipse in over a century
item.description: As the sky darkened, gradually at first and then quickly, people broke into applause and cheered. It was the Spain's first total solar eclipse in more than a century.

item.title: Controversial group wins $158M-contract to represent unaccompanied immigrant children
item.description: Utah-based Our Rescue was founded by activist Tim Ballard. It was previously known as Operation Underground Railroad and it says it helps law enforcement perform sting operations and rescues human trafficking survivors.
